source.retainedRelativePath: Not bundled; caller-supplied cached RSS verified by the declared SHA-256
source.captureContext: Already recovered June5,2023 RSS body; no refetch.

matching: ASCII case-insensitive literal substring matching; no word boundaries, stemming, spelling correction or punctuation deletion. All occurrences of every term are retained, including plural/compound substrings that contain the exact literal.
htmlToText: Parse each actual field occurrence locally with HTMLParser(convert_charrefs=True), discard markup/comments, retain all character data without script/style filtering, and insert whitespace at block/br boundaries; decode XML/HTML character references normally. Never fetch links/entities.
whitespace: Collapse runs of whitespace to one U+0020 and trim outer whitespace only; no other Unicode or case normalization of stored text. Case insensitivity affects matching only.
population: Every direct channel/item in stored order; require165. Search all occurrences of all5fields, including repeated field elements. Do not deduplicate items or fields.
contextPolicy: Fixed up-to100codepoints before/after each literal match. Save contexts privately, without semantic/promising-substring selection. Record observed hrefs from matching fields as source pointers only; do not follow.
coverage: For each field, count present/missing item slots, empty/nonempty-after-text-conversion slots, total elements/empty elements. Preserve per-item field states and GUID, plus hit item title/pubDate/GUID and field occurrence identities.
scope: Metadata index audit, not decoding or an independent theory. A zero for a term/field does not establish absence in audio, frames, item enclosures, feed history or creator history. Hits are context leads, not puzzle instructions.

publicationPort.change: Private cache path descriptor and unrelated operational privacy wording generalized. Terms, fields, matching, normalization, source pin and fixed context radius are unchanged.
